marcadas.claim: src/escalimetro/ is the motor: plano (JPG/PNG/PDF) -> floorplate.json -> layouts CP-SAT
marcadas.evidence: Code inspection of the working tree (HEAD == origin/m01_ai_handoff == 2efd0c3). `grep -rn -i 'pdf' src/escalimetro --include='*.py'` found nothing. src/escalimetro/pipeline.py:74 run() does `img = cv2.imread(cfg.image_path)`, so it only reads raster images. pipeline.py:310 `fp.save(out("floorplate.json"))`. layout/e05/cpsolver.py:24 `from ortools.sat.python import cp_model`. PDF handling is in the webapp: webapp/intake.py:109-116 rasterizes page 1 of a PDF with pymupdf into preview.png before the motor runs.
marcadas.correct_value: The floorplate.json -> CP-SAT layout path is correct. The motor itself does not accept PDF: it reads raster images with cv2.imread. The webapp intake takes PDF/PNG/JPG and rasterizes PDFs before handing them to the motor.

marcadas.claim: /lab/* is the internal LAB: plano comercial + layout tipo + ambientación (E28–E36); the diagram lists /case, /lab and /property as the webapp surfaces
marcadas.evidence: webapp/lab.py:33 Blueprint('lab', url_prefix='/lab'). Its docstring starts 'E32 — ESCALÍMETRO LAB'. git log --diff-filter=A -- webapp/lab.py → 9ebc996 2026-09-21 'E32.4 - ESCALIMETRO LAB: una sola consola'. webapp/app.py:50-55 also registers two more blueprints: customer.bp (url_prefix='/properties', E28.5, added in 37ba16a) and staging_ui.bp (url_prefix='/staging', E31.4, added in b148241). app.py also has /benchmark, /review and /run routes.

The E28–E31 features also live in the /properties blueprint (customer surface, E28.5/E30) and the /staging blueprint (staging review, E31.4), and the diagram leaves both out.

marcadas.claim: THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED = umbral del motor que todavía no tiene muestra para validarse (D-005)
marcadas.evidence: git grep THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED origin/m01_ai_handoff -- src -> no hits. Defined at webapp/domain/ingest.py:107 THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED = 'THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED' as a calibration_status label for AUTO_CONFIRM_THRESHOLDS (ingest.py:68). Used in webapp/domain/calibration.py, where MIN_SAMPLE = 10 (l.84). D-005 (DECISIONS.md l.58-62) matches the meaning.
marcadas.correct_value: THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED is a status label in the webapp's LAB ingest layer (webapp/domain/ingest.py, calibration.py). It marks the auto-confirm geometry thresholds. It is not a threshold in the motor (src/escalimetro), which has no occurrence of it.

marcadas.evidence: E30 pricing is public: origin/e30_product_direction:docs/E30_PRODUCT_DIRECTION.md:21 reads '| Precio hipótesis | ~USD 100 / propiedad | cuota mensual |' (also E28_NEXT_STEPS 'USD 99', E32_2 'Packs de ~USD 100'). marcadas.claim: /property puts at its center a scoring that D-001 declares an application
marcadas.evidence: /property is built around the publication diagnosis (webapp/domain/potential/analyzer.py). However, commit 43e46af ('E17.1.2 - potencial, no puntaje: oportunidades primero') moved the numeric score out of the center. webapp/templates/potential/listing.html:63-65 leads with 'LAS OPORTUNIDADES PRIMERO'. The score sits at lines 110-114 inside a collapsed <details> labelled 'el diagnóstico completo, secundario' / 'Ver diagnóstico completo'.
marcadas.correct_value: /property is built on the publication-scoring analyzer, but the numeric score is deliberately secondary (collapsed 'Ver diagnóstico completo'). The page leads with opportunities derived from that diagnosis.

marcadas.claim: THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED is an engine threshold that does not yet have a sample to validate it (D-005)
marcadas.evidence: git grep THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED origin/m01_ai_handoff -- src returns nothing. It is defined at webapp/domain/ingest.py:107 as a status flag ('mientras la muestra no alcance, los umbrales se declaran NO calibrados') and is used in webapp/domain/calibration.py. It is not a threshold itself, and it is not in the engine (src/escalimetro, frozen since E28). The link to D-005 is correct.
marcadas.correct_value: THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED is a status flag in webapp/domain/ingest.py (the webapp ingest/LAB layer, E35). It marks the auto-accept thresholds on engine confidences as uncalibrated. It is not a threshold, and it does not live in the engine (src/).

marcadas.claim: los docs/E*.md guardaban el razonamiento de diseño de cada fase, pero no su estado, sus tests ni su resultado

marcadas.correct_value: They are listed in CURRENT_STATE.md, but commit history shows failures in test_e12_hardening and test_e15_case_contract were already documented at E27 (2026-09-10) as machine-local, caused by gitignored PNGs. They predate E34. The exact current failures cannot be confirmed without running the suite.

marcadas.claim: Por tarea: tests/test_<id>_*.py
marcadas.evidence: git ls-tree tests/: E-phase tests follow the pattern (test_e28_property_pipeline.py, test_e36_real_pilot.py, ...). M01's own test is tests/test_ai_handoff.py, not test_m01_*.py.
marcadas.correct_value: Most E-phase tests follow the convention, but M01, the task that introduced it, does not: its test is tests/test_ai_handoff.py.

marcadas.claim: Pasada 1: 7 respondidas · 4 parciales · 1 sin respuesta
marcadas.evidence: reconstruction_pass1.md header says 'Score: 7 ANSWERED, 4 PARTIAL, 1 NOT_ANSWERED.' Its per-question grades tally differently: git show ...reconstruction_pass1.md | grep -E '^[0-9]+\. \*\*.*\?' | grep -oE '(NOT_ANSWERED|PARTIAL|ANSWERED)' | sort | uniq -c -> 8 ANSWERED, 3 PARTIAL, 1 NOT_ANSWERED (Q1, Q7, Q8 PARTIAL; Q9 NOT_ANSWERED; Q2-6 and Q10-12 ANSWERED).
marcadas.correct_value: The README matches the transcript's header, but the 12 per-question grades in the committed transcript add up to 8 answered, 3 partial and 1 unanswered. The transcript contradicts itself.

marcadas.claim: Transcripciones condensadas en inglés; se conservaron todas las calificaciones y todos los hallazgos, con su numeración
marcadas.evidence: The answers are in English, and findings are numbered 1-14 (pass 1) and 1-12 (pass 2). The raw agent output is not in the repo, so completeness cannot be checked. The pass-1 per-question grades (8/3/1) do not match its own header score (7/4/1), which suggests at least one grade was altered or lost when condensing.
marcadas.correct_value: The language and numbering claims are correct, but the claim that all grades were preserved is contradicted by the internal mismatch in reconstruction_pass1.md.

critico.claim: Un número no se reutiliza. (The only acknowledged exception is the two E17 series, which CURRENT_STATE lists as its single ID inconsistency.)
critico.evidence: `git log --format='%h %cs %s' origin/main..origin/m01_ai_handoff` shows several more reused numbers. E32.2: ef63c37 'E32.2 - avance y linea de tiempo DERIVADOS' (a step of E32) and the e32_2_entitlement_semantics task (65db238..b2074d2 'E32.2a'..'E32.2e'). E36.1: 4bdbfcb 'E36.1 - un instrumento para medir...' and cb6581a 'E36.1 - solo cuenta como verdad lo que miro una persona'. E36.2: 9514caf 'E36.2 - todo el QA ocurre dentro de la pagina' and ae64d35 'E36.2 - el contador de procedencia lleva denominador'. E28.6: 7047b8f and 637889d (637889d comes after E28.7). Engine E17 is ef6dc6a (2026-09-08); product E17.0 is 7572d06 (2026-09-24).
critico.correct_value: As a rule for new IDs it is fine. As a description of the repo, numbers were already reused beyond E17: E32.2, E36.1, E36.2 and E28.6. CURRENT_STATE 'Inconsistencias conocidas' lists only E17. D-005 cites 'E36.1', which is ambiguous because of this collision.

critico.section: DR-1 Recomendación técnica (checkers marked it TRUE; new counter-evidence)
critico.claim: Mergear la cadena en main (opción A) es seguro: D-004 y DEPLOY_GATE siguen protegiendo producción
critico.evidence: README.md on origin/m01_ai_handoff, lines 52-83, has the table 'Railway — dos servicios en el proyecto ESCALIMETRO'. Service `backend` (E09–E12) lists branch `main`. Its start command `PYTHONPATH=src python -m escalimetro.ai.railway_e09_runner` runs the E09 experiment on every start, which calls OpenAI and Anthropic. The README says 'cada redeploy costaría dinero'. Service `web` (E27) lists branch `e27_internal_web_app`. No handoff doc mentions this.
critico.correct_value: The repo records a Railway service (`backend`) that deploys from `main`. If Railway auto-deploys on push, fast-forwarding main (option A) would redeploy it and run a paid E09 experiment. D-004 and DEPLOY_GATE only cover the web product, not this side effect. The DR-1 context ('Producción tampoco corre desde main') leaves this service out.

critico.section: Producción / Bloqueos (checkers split TRUE/PARTIAL; new evidence)
critico.claim: No está registrado en el repo ni qué commit está desplegado ni la URL
critico.evidence: README.md (m01) table and DEPLOY.md step 3 ('En Settings → Source, elegir la rama e27_internal_web_app') record the deployed branch of the web service. `git ls-remote origin` gives refs/heads/e27_internal_web_app = 1ae6a0b, which is 'ESCALIMETRO E27.3 - un caso con geometria se muestra como analizado'. DEPLOY.md step 6 says the URL is a generated Railway domain, and no concrete URL is recorded.
critico.correct_value: The URL is not recorded. The deployed source branch is recorded (e27_internal_web_app, tip 1ae6a0b = E27.3), and it matches the 'e27.3' production state. Only the exact commit that is live is unconfirmed.

critico.claim: Todo en castellano: docstrings, comentarios, commits
critico.evidence: The 19 commits from E16.13.1 to E22 have English subjects in `git log origin/m01_ai_handoff`, e.g. 37558b8 'ESCALIMETRO E22 - evaluator sensitivity under frozen QA evidence', ef6dc6a 'ESCALIMETRO E17 - structural width representation spike', c6de3f9 (main tip) 'E16.12 - record multi-component architecture blocker evidence'. The src/escalimetro docstrings I sampled (ai/config.py, ai/costs.py, ai/e09.py) are Spanish. experiments/M01 transcripts are English, which experiments/M01/README.md acknowledges.
critico.correct_value: This holds as a rule going forward. Historically, commits E16.13.1–E22 (including main's tip) are in English.

critico.section: Principios / CORE 1 Entrada (provenance via D-001 → tasks/M01.md §Fuente)
critico.claim: The doctrine is the persisted form of the approved M01 source (D-001 Origen: tasks/M01.md §Fuente · persistido en PRODUCT_DOCTRINE.md)
critico.evidence: `git grep -n -iE 'remoto|antecedentes p[uú]blicos|visita f[ií]sica' origin/m01_ai_handoff -- '*.md'` returns only PRODUCT_DOCTRINE.md:49 ('Producto 100 % remoto'). tasks/M01.md §Fuente ('Doctrina.' paragraph) has the core, the 90/10 goal and the list of applications. It has neither principle 4 (100 % remoto, sin visita física) nor principle 5 (honestidad de la evidencia por encima de la métrica), nor the CREAR PLANO input list (dirección y contexto, antecedentes públicos verificables). The doctrine's Joaquín-authority row also drops two §Fuente items: 'el problema' and 'cuándo algo está listo'.
critico.correct_value: Parts of the doctrine (principles 4–5 and the detailed input lists) cannot be traced to anything in the repo. They may come from the original out-of-repo document, which cannot be checked. Every other element resolves to §Fuente.

critico.section: §5.1 Quién escribe cada archivo (as applied to M01)
critico.claim: tasks/<ID>.md lo commitea Claude, como primer paso de la tarea, en la rama de la tarea
critico.evidence: `git show --stat origin/m01_ai_handoff` shows one commit, 2efd0c3 (2026-09-29), that adds tasks/M01.md together with reports/M01_REPORT.md, CURRENT_STATE.md and the rest (14 files). `git rev-list --count origin/e17_2_url_first_ingest..origin/m01_ai_handoff` = 1.
critico.correct_value: M01 did not follow the rule: the TASK went into the same single final commit as the REPORT, not into a first commit. That may be acceptable because the protocol was written during M01, but no doc says so.

critico.claim: doctrina persistida con el core y los roles: PRODUCT_DOCTRINE.md, D-001, D-002
critico.evidence: PRODUCT_DOCTRINE.md on origin/m01_ai_handoff has '## El core' (CREAR/MEJORAR PLANO) and '## Roles' (Joaquín, ChatGPT, Claude Code). DECISIONS.md has D-001 (core) and D-002 (roles).

critico.claim: tasks/ y reports/ — con M01 como primer ciclo real
critico.evidence: `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/e17_2_url_first_ingest | grep -E '^tasks/|^reports/'` returns nothing, so neither directory existed before M01. In 2efd0c3 the only files are tasks/M01.md and reports/M01_REPORT.md.
DECISIONS.md is added in 2efd0c3, committed 2026-09-29 10:21:41 -0300 (`git log -1 --format='%ci' origin/m01_ai_handoff`). The 'vigente desde E30' part was already covered.

critico.claim: Lo que mide [la muestra de 20 avisos] —si el diagnóstico acierta y si vale la pena contactar— es sobre el scoring
critico.evidence: webapp/domain/potential/reviews.py (origin/m01_ai_handoff) lines 1-15: 'E17.1 §4/§5 — LA REVISIÓN HUMANA DEL DIAGNÓSTICO, y el tablero del dogfood de 20 avisos'. It records three judgments: DIAGNÓSTICO (ACERTADO/PARCIAL/EQUIVOCADO), OPORTUNIDAD (HAY_ALGO/NO_HAY) and CONTACTAR (SÍ/NO). webapp/store.py:591 and templates/potential/dogfood.html say the same.
critico.correct_value: Accurate. The sample also records a third judgment, OPORTUNIDAD, which the report does not mention.

critico.claim: Aprobar la licencia y habilitar BFL en el bake-off (premise: BFL is currently disabled in the bake-off)
critico.evidence: webapp/domain/pilot.py:32-38 has `EXCLUDED = {"bfl": "DESHABILITADO — requiere decisión de licencia ..."}` and `PILOT_PROVIDERS = ("openai", "gemini")`, with the comment 'Los que participan del bake-off de E31.1'. webapp/lab.py:697 and webapp/benchmark.py:359 filter out excluded providers. The BFL adapter still exists in webapp/providers/bfl.py.
critico.correct_value: The premise holds. The exclusion comes from E31.1 §2 (the pilot.py comment), not E31: docs/E31_PROVIDER_DECISION.md §4 says BFL is 'aceptable' for the own-photo bake-off and leaves only client photos to Joaquín. So '(D-006, E31)' is attributed to the wrong phase.
